reviews.title: This has exceeded expectations so far
reviews.body: I've only had this for a few days, so far it has exceeded my expectations in everyway. The build quality is far better than i expected including the hinge design. It came with the HP pen in the box, something I was unsure of. I find computers frustrating and I've truly hated my windows ten pc since
reviews.excerpt: I have it connected wirelessly to my Samsung s23 ultra, it took about a minute to do so.
